query: Create a Jira ticket for adding a keyboard-visible focus state to the primary button in facilitron-ui. The Figma source is https://figma.com/file/button-focus and Maya signs off Friday.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as engineering work for facilitron-ui and uses the UI summary prefix
Fetches or otherwise grounds the named Figma source before drafting context details
Collects the pilot template's fields, including at least two numbered, checkable acceptance criteria (AC1, AC2) and the sections an engineering ticket needs
Takes the Stakeholder only from the user (Maya, as stated) and never adds or infers anyone else
Adds an optional one-sentence Intent marker only if the supplied source evidence establishes the desired user or system outcome
Shows the people description and the engineering brief, with the brief's verdict at the created stage, before creating the Jira ticket
Creates only after approval, using md-to-adf and acli, attaches the brief as <KEY>-engineering.md, then verifies the stored ticket, its brief and the assignee
